dedupe_keys.name: donnees du marche francais du transport ferroviaire de voyageurs et de marchandises

description: Données du marché français du transport ferroviaire de voyageurs et de marchandises is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autorité de régulation des transports (anciennement Arafer). Content of the dataset: this includes the main indicators relating to the characteristics of the national rail network (NRF) and rail transport markets (supply, demand, economic and financial performance of passenger and freight transport activities). It also contains detailed data on the quality of service of rail transport. Coverage: Autorité de régulation des transports (anciennement Arafer). The portal shows the English title as "Data on the French market for rail passenger and freight transport" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autorité de régulation des transports (anciennement Arafer). Its keywords include fret, ter, transilien, ferroviaire, rfn, transport-de-marchandises. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
